verdict.rationale: Temporal has a full-featured CLI (temporal server start-dev, workflow list, operator commands) and Docker/Kubernetes deployment options that enable headless operation and CI-driven workflow execution without a GUI, plus SDKs for programmatic workflow/worker management suitable for automation pipelines. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or documented GitHub Actions/CI integration, no dedicated headless-mode flag documentation, and community evidence flags rough edges in self-hosted operational/error visibility that could affect CI reliability.
